programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u075/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    blocks = []
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w - 1):
            if all(grid[rr][cc] == 2 for rr, cc in ((r, c), (r, c + 1), (r + 1, c), (r + 1, c + 1))):
                blocks.append((r, c))
    for r, c in blocks:
        corners = [(r - 1, c - 1), (r - 1, c + 2), (r + 2, c - 1), (r + 2, c + 2)]
        if not all(0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w for rr, cc in corners):
            continue
        nw, ne, sw, se = (grid[rr][cc] for rr, cc in corners)
        values = [sw, nw, se, ne]
        directions = [(-1, -1), (-1, 1), (1, -1), (1, 1)]
        for (rr, cc), value, (dr, dc) in zip(corners, values, directions):
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = value
                rr += dr
                cc += dc
    return out
'''
